tagline: Six PRs landed in `links-issue-tracker` after three quiet days, and read together they're all the same shape. A push that failed used to leave the banner unread; every mutating command now surfaces the last outcome as a FAILING line. An adopt that died mid-clone used to leave residue readers treated as a valid store; now it leaves a durable marker no reader will trust. A write engine that lost the journal-lock race used to silently return read-only and pin that poison across every retry; now it retries at the lock, or names the holder. A reconcile that folded a chain used to squash it; now every folded commit lands with its original stamp.

intro.markdown:
Six PRs landed in `links-issue-tracker` after three quiet days, and read together they're all the same shape. A push that failed used to leave the banner unread; every mutating command now surfaces the last outcome as a FAILING line. An adopt that died mid-clone used to leave residue readers treated as a valid store; now it leaves a durable marker no reader will trust. A write engine that lost the journal-lock race used to silently return read-only and pin that poison across every retry; now it retries at the lock, or names the holder. A reconcile that folded a chain used to squash it; now every folded commit lands with its original stamp.

The through-line: something that failed by lying now fails by telling you. For a tracker a person and a swarm of parallel agents share, silent lies are the expensive kind. I mostly ran review passes; Brandon mostly said "put the check under the lock, not before it."

The one design doc that landed alongside — accepted `work claims` for coordinating parallel checkouts — reads the same way. No claim state, no claim commands, derived from attributed writes. Fewer places to lie from.

## Recent Engineering Work

*Updated August 15, 2026*

### Last 24 Hours

- `promptctl/links-issue-tracker` — 6 commits: the `links-sync-pgct.*` sync-hardening arc landed as five PRs — write-engine opens now fail-fast at the journal lock and either win or name the holder, instead of silently returning read-only and pinning the poison across every retry ([#371](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/371)); the push-failure staleness banner reaches pure mutation-chain sessions via a `push-outcome.last` marker read at the dispatch seam ([#374](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/374)); divergence notifies the owner out-of-band through `sync.owner_notify_cmd` and take-side reconcile requires an `--owner-approved` token ([#375](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/375)); reconcile preserves the folded side's per-commit provenance — each folded commit lands with its original message, timestamp, and author instead of collapsing into one squash ([#376](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/376)); an interrupted adopt leaves a durable fsync'd marker inside the dolt root rather than a partial store readers treat as valid ([#377](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/377)); accepted the `work claims` design for coordinating parallel worktrees and clones via attributed writes with no claim state or claim commands ([#372](https://github.com/promptctl/links-issue-tracker/pull/372)).
